available_rules.name: 200-session trend regime
available_rules.description: Active when close exceeds SMA200; trigger on the first close crossing above it. Cash is unremunerated in the descriptive comparison.

available_rules.name: Golden cross
available_rules.description: SMA50 crosses from at/below to above SMA200. A lagging trend event, not an entry guarantee.

available_rules.name: Death cross
available_rules.description: SMA50 crosses from at/above to below SMA200. Success means the underlying later fell, not a simulated short profit.

available_rules.name: RSI(2) pullback <5
available_rules.description: Wilder RSI2 <5 and close >SMA200. Explicit pullback variant; next-close entry and next-close exit after close >SMA5.

available_rules.name: RSI(2) pullback <10
available_rules.description: Same pullback rule at RSI2 <10. Related threshold comparison increases selection risk.

available_rules.name: Volume-confirmed closing breakout
available_rules.description: Close exceeds the previous 20 closes and volume is at least 1.5 times the previous 20-session mean. Daily-close rule, not intraday confirmation.

unavailable_rules.name: VIX >30 close-back-below reversal
unavailable_rules.need: Dated authorized VIX close history aligned to the equity benchmark. Intraday 10–15% reversal requires intraday data.

unavailable_rules.name: VIX / VIX3M cross below 1
unavailable_rules.need: Matched daily VIX and VIX3M history. VIX3M is a three-month implied-volatility index, not a futures price.

unavailable_rules.name: Cboe equity put/call >1
unavailable_rules.need: Consistent equity-only option-volume history and reuse rights; single-stock OI ratios are not substitutes.

unavailable_rules.name: AAII bears >50%
unavailable_rules.need: Authorized dated survey history and actual publication timestamps.

unavailable_rules.name: 9:1 up/down volume days
unavailable_rules.need: Historical exchange-wide up/down volume with consistent eligible-issue definitions.

unavailable_rules.name: Zweig breadth thrust
unavailable_rules.need: Historical exchange advances/declines and a fixed 10-session EMA specification. Current SPY constituents cannot recreate it.

unavailable_rules.name: Whaley / 5-day advance-decline thrust
unavailable_rules.need: Verified original rule definition and historical exchange advances/declines. The supplied name/variant is not treated as validated.

unavailable_rules.name: Clustered Hindenburg Omen
unavailable_rules.need: Complete historical new highs/lows, exchange universe, trend and breadth conditions. Definitions differ; 2.2–2.8% alone is incomplete.

unavailable_rules.name: Turn of the month
unavailable_rules.need: Verified exchange-session calendar, complete adjusted benchmark history and fixed entry/exit convention.

unavailable_rules.name: Pre-FOMC drift
unavailable_rules.need: Historical scheduled announcement timestamps and intraday benchmark prices. Daily-close returns cannot test a 24-hour announcement window faithfully.

unavailable_rules.name: Santa Claus / January barometer
unavailable_rules.need: Verified session calendar and decades of adjusted prices; current three-year coverage gives too few independent annual events.

unavailable_rules.name: Quarterly expiration / post-expiration week
unavailable_rules.need: Exchange calendars and long adjusted OHLCV history. Volume seasonality is separate from direction. Intraday pinning/dealer hedging is not observable here.

unavailable_rules.name: Midterm election cycle
unavailable_rules.need: Many decades of prices with independently specified election windows; three years cannot support a multi-cycle inference. Claims of never losing are not assumed.

method: Close t signal; entry close t+1; fixed-horizon exit h observed sessions later. Same-horizon event windows do not overlap. Wins are direction-correct underlying moves, before costs, not trade profitability. Zero returns are not wins. RSI exit-rule results separately include 10 bps per side. Baseline uses all eligible dates and overlaps. Wilson intervals are descriptive binomial intervals, not dependence- or selection-adjusted probabilities. Fixed final 30% holdout; no parameters fitted. Present holdings and unadjusted prices limit inference. Horizons are observed bars, not a verified exchange calendar. No claim of a validated edge.
